name: ucl-matchday-concierge
description: UEFA Champions League Matchday Concierge — a production-grade, guardrailed enterprise agent.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:guardrails
